event.quote: pain in my upper right belly
event.text: Have you had any nausea, vomiting, or swelling of your belly during these episodes?
event.why: Nausea, vomiting, and abdominal distension are key features that help distinguish biliary colic from other causes of RUQ pain and guide urgency of imaging.
